lesson.name: Lesson
lesson.description: Pages of content and questions joined by jumps: the way through depends on the answers

settings.customScoring: Answers carry their own points (otherwise a correct answer is one point)
settings.retake: Learners may take the lesson again
settings.useMaxGrade: With retakes, the best attempt counts (otherwise their mean)
settings.minQuestionsHint: Fewer questions answered count as wrong ones
settings.review: After a wrong answer, offer to try the question again
settings.feedback: Say whether every answer was correct
settings.displayMenu: Show a menu of content pages
settings.passwordHint: Learners enter it to start; leave empty for none
settings.completionEnd: Reach the end of the lesson
settings.completionTime: Spend at least this many minutes

lesson.previewing: You are trying the lesson out: nothing is graded or reported.
lesson.tryAgainHint: That answer was wrong. Try again or go on.
lesson.essaySent: Your answer is sent to the teacher.
lesson.ended: You reached the end of the lesson
lesson.pendingEssays: {n, plural, one {# essay is} other {# essays are}} still to be graded by the teacher.
lesson.noPages: The lesson has no pages yet.
lesson.notOpen: The lesson is not open yet.
lesson.noRetakes: The lesson cannot be taken again.

jumps.unseenBranch: Unseen question in the content page's branch
jumps.randomBranch: Random question in the content page's branch

edit.title: Title

about.endofbranch: Ends the branch of a content page: by default the learner goes back to the content page seen last.
about.cluster: Starts a cluster: the learner gets questions of the cluster not answered yet, in random order.
about.endofcluster: Ends the cluster: by default the lesson goes on with the next page.

edit.question: Question
edit.multiple: Several answers are correct (all of them must be chosen)
edit.numberHint: One number (5) or a range min:max (4.5:5.5)
edit.deleteConfirm: Delete the page “{title}”? Answers given to it go with it.
edit.empty: The lesson has no pages yet. Add the first one.

reports.deleteConfirm: Delete this attempt? The learner's grade is reckoned again.
reports.empty: Nobody has taken the lesson yet.

errors.notOpenYet: The lesson is not open yet
errors.noRetake: The lesson cannot be taken again
